angellist-angellist:lever:f0b55531-5539-.title: Head of Data
angellist-angellist:lever:f0b55531-5539-.description: Why Join AngelList We’re solving some of the hardest problems in venture capital and private markets. You’ll work with a team that values precision, urgency, and long-term thinking. If you want to shape how startups are funded and built, this is the place. About AngelList We exist to accelerate innovation by increasing the number of successful startups in the world. We do this by building the financial infrastructure that makes it easier for more people to invest in world-changing companies. AngelList is the nexus of venture capital and the startup community. We support $171B+ in assets and have powered investments into over 13,000 startups—over 300 of which are unicorns. Today, 57% of top-tier U.S. VC deals involve investors on AngelList. While our scale is large, our ambition is larger. If you're excited to build the future of private markets, come build with us. About the Role We're hiring a Head of Data to turn AngelList's data into an unfair advantage. AngelList sits in a rare position. We support $171B in assets across 25,000+ funds and syndicates, with $80B+ moved across our banking infrastructure. 80% of the top 10 2025 Midas List VCs invest in funds on AngelList. Our network spans 2,300+ GPs and 72,000+ LPs, the largest in private markets, and we have over a decade of venture fund transaction data underneath it. We've reached $100M+ ARR with essentially zero marketing spend and we're ready to invest. The business is unusual: a marketplace, an investing platform, a banking partner, and a software + services business, all reinforcing each other. The data implications are extraordinary, and most of the interesting questions are still unanswered. Those questions are the work. How do the business units actually compound on each other? What's the right attribution model when one product introduces a customer to another? What does incrementality look like when our channels are dominated by network and reputation rather than paid acquisition? What's the LTV of a fund manager vs. an LP vs. a banking customer, and how should that change where we invest? Our data team spent the last year earning trust in the numbers: Snowflake live, pipelines reliable, a shared source of truth. That foundation is mostly there. What we want next is the layer on top: attribution we trust, incrementality we can measure, segmentations and forecasts that change how we invest, experimentation as default. You'll lead a small, senior team of three to start, and personally do a meaningful share of the work and shaping of the team. For a growth-focused data scientist ready to do both, there aren't many roles like it.
responsibilities: Decision science. Own attribution, incrementality, LTV / CAC, customer segmentation, forecasting, and experimentation across our business units. Set the methodologies, defend them, and improve them as we learn.

Flywheel measurement. Build the analytical view of how our businesses (admin, Carry, Ark, Meridian) reinforce each other, where the flywheel is real, where it’s aspirational, and what investments accelerate it.
Experimentation. Make running good experiments the default for product, marketing, and growth, with the infrastructure and review process to back it up.
The data platform. Inherit a working platform with real gaps. Decide which gaps to fill, which to accept, and how to keep investing so the foundation grows with the demands you’re putting on it.
The team. Three people today, a mix of data engineering and analytics. Grow it deliberately. We expect early hires to be data scientists who reflect the bar you set, not headcount for its own sake.
Executive partnership. Be a thought partner to the CFO, CEO, and the GMs, in the room for capital allocation and GTM decisions, not summarizing them afterward.

ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:8.title: Regional Outside Sales Specialist, Educational Services - Detroit
ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:8.description: This position requires the employee to reside in the Detroit, MI area and involves local travel, approximately 80–90% of the time, or 4–5 days per week in the field. Join Aya Healthcare, winner of multiple Top Workplace awards! The Regional Outside Sales Specialist, which is formally titled Regional Client Partnership Specialist, Educational Services, is Aya Education’s field leader and plays a central role in expanding our presence within school districts across the region. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strong district partnerships, assessing full-scope staffing needs, generating job requests, and identifying opportunities for long-term, scalable workforce solutions. Most of your week will be spent onsite in schools and district offices, meeting with SPED Directors, HR leaders, SELPA administrators, Principals, and other key decision-makers. You’ll serve as the face of Aya Education in your region and help ensure districts have access to qualified special education and therapy professionals who support meaningful outcomes for students from early childhood through age 21. Who We Are: We’re a $8+ billion, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform. At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally. Responsibilities: New Business Development Conduct 5–8 daily walk-ins or 3–4 scheduled meetings with district leaders in order to generate new business Identify, pursue, and secure new business opportunities within assigned markets Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of target districts in order to win new business Generate new job orders across SPED, paraeducator, therapy, behavioral health, and general education support roles Recognize early indicators that may suggest future MSP opportunities Relationship Building and Account Expansion: Develop strong, long-term partnerships with district leadership Visit clients and prospects 4–5 days per week to build familiarity and deepen relationships Conduct onsite assessments to uncover unmet staffing needs and expand existing accounts Serve as Aya’s local market representative and a trusted partner to district teams Collaboration and Cross-Functional Alignment Partner with Account Managers to ensure job orders are filled quickly and accurately Work closely with internal teams, including Recruitment, AM Leadership, Compliance, and Licensing, to support overall account growth Maintain accurate documentation of walk-ins, meetings, and district insights in HubSpot Educate districts on LotusOne, demonstrate platform value, and support onboarding Field Intelligence and Strategic Insights Track and report on competitive activity, district budget cycles, and hiring trends Identify patterns such as high call-offs, multi-agency usage, inconsistent fill rates, or staffing gaps Use field insights to inform long-term MSP strategy Representation and Events Represent Aya Education at conferences, regional events, and district engagements Deliver polished presentations and talking points tailored to school leadership Increase awareness

We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs for the benefit of people and planet. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Position Summary We are seeking an Executive Search Operations Analyst to join Flagship Pioneering’s Talent Acquisition team. In this hands-on role, you will support executive search execution across Flagship and its portfolio companies, with a strong focus on back-end AI-focused operations, such as template creation for reporting and content support. The ideal candidate is highly proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable using AI-enabled tools to build and refine recruiting materials, streamline documentation and enable workflows to move with precision and urgency. A major part of the role involves building trusted client relationships from initial conversations through long-term partnerships. You’ll translate business requirements into clear product direction while collaborating closely with developers and AI-assisted tools. The position combines product strategy, stakeholder management, consultative communication, and account growth. You’ll work within a highly distributed international environment alongside professionals across multiple countries and time zones. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end, including discovery, product strategy, roadmap definition, prioritization, delivery, and iteration based on client, user, and market feedback. Lead client interactions from initial discussions and onboarding through ongoing account management, building relationships that support long-term partnerships. Translate client needs, business objectives, and user feedback into clear product requirements and actionable priorities for development teams. Collaborate with engineers and AI-assisted tools to define solutions, clarify requirements, and support effective product delivery. Build prototypes and contribute to product strategy, helping stakeholders visualize solutions and align around product direction. Communicate product value in a consultative manner by educating and advising clients rather than relying on a transactional sales approach. Proactively engage existing accounts to identify issues early, manage expectations, gather feedback, and uncover opportunities for renewal and expansion. Develop strong, trusted relationships that contribute to retention, account growth, and referrals. Collect, evaluate, and prioritize feedback from clients, users, internal stakeholders, and market signals to continuously improve the product roadmap. Bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring product priorities and business objectives remain aligned throughout the development process. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with demonstrated experience defining roadmaps, managing backlogs, prioritizing features, and working with development teams. Proven experience in a client-facing role involving business development, sales, account management, or consultative relationship building. Demonstrated ability to retain and grow customer accounts over time, rather than focusing solely on new business acquisition. Strong client relationship-building skills and a consultative, customer-first approach. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex product concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Native or near-native proficiency in spoken and written English. Experience building prototypes and translating early-stage ideas into actionable product strategies and requirements. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and incorporating emerging technologies into product development workflows. Ability to work independently and effectively within a fully distributed, international team across multiple time zones. Strong organizational skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to balance competing priorities. A proactive, relationship-oriented mindset with a strong focus on long-term customer success.
